dns-migration.title: Domain migrated to Cloudflare
dns-migration.description: DNS zone moved from Porkbun to Cloudflare, with custom domains for the apex and www; www redirects to the apex.

contact-form.title: Contact form working in production
contact-form.description: The cause was that Cloudflare Workers doesn't support redirect: 'error' in fetch; fixed by using redirect: 'manual'.

adr-0006-0009.title: Architecture Decision Records (ADR) 0006-0009
adr-0006-0009.description: Documented the DNS, CI structure, launch feature-flag and contact-security decisions.

changelog-page.title: Changelog page
changelog-page.description: This very log: a place to see visible site changes as they ship.

ci-direct-to-main.title: CI/CD simplified: nothing runs while working on develop
ci-direct-to-main.description: Pushing to develop no longer triggers anything. The only automated check now happens on the direct push to main, which also deploys if everything passes.

staging-removed.title: Staging environment removed
staging-removed.description: The staging Worker and its GitHub environment were decommissioned; the site now runs on a single production environment.

me-real-data.title: /me page with real data
me-real-data.description: Real work experience, certificates and education replace the placeholder content; the page is now public.

seo-hardening.title: Social image, security headers and a sitemap with real dates
seo-hardening.description: A default image for shared links, security headers (nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy), and real last-modified dates in the sitemap.

web-analytics.title: Cloudflare Web Analytics enabled
web-analytics.description: Basic visit metrics, no cookies, no extra JavaScript weight for visitors.

background-picker.title: Visual background picker
background-picker.description: Pick the animated banner effect (galaxy, waves, or off) from the navbar; your choice is remembered in the browser.

background-picker-firefox-fix.title: Background broke in Firefox after switching effects a few times
background-picker-firefox-fix.description: Firefox was losing the graphics context after a couple of switches, leaving the background blank. Fixed by reusing the same context instead of opening a new one on every switch.

home-visual-refinement.title: Calmer home: softer hero, photo and lighter cards
home-visual-refinement.description: The animated banner now fades into the page, the blinking brand text is gone, the author photo is shown, and the hiring card is less crowded.

sitewide-ui-polish.title: Easier reading and a language hint that stays out of the way
sitewide-ui-polish.description: The language suggestion no longer covers content, privacy text follows a comfortable reading width, decorative blinking is calmer, and English note pages now open instead of showing a 404.

privacy-local-storage.title: Privacy page now lists every preference saved in your browser
privacy-local-storage.description: It only mentioned the theme and the language hint; it now also covers the background effect you pick and whether the banner is expanded.

hiring-status-dot.title: Hiring card no longer shows a green dot when I am not available
hiring-status-dot.description: The status dot now follows whether I am open to work: green when I am, red when I am not (currently working at Buo).

note-comments.title: Comments and reactions on notes
note-comments.description: Every note now has a discussion area powered by giscus: comments and reactions live in GitHub Discussions, you sign in with GitHub to take part, and nothing loads until you scroll down to it.

first-notes.title: First two Lab Notes
first-notes.description: How this site was built, and the multi-agent development setup behind it, both written in Spanish.

link-previews.title: Shared links now show a proper card
link-previews.description: Each note gets its own preview image with its title, and /me shows my photo, role and availability. The previews also carry correct language, alt text and article details.

reading-mode.title: Reading mode for notes
reading-mode.description: A button on every note switches to a calm single column: no banner effects or sidebar, larger text and wider margins on phones. It is remembered in your browser and you can leave it any time.

terms-and-privacy.title: Terms of use and a clearer privacy page
terms-and-privacy.description: New terms page linked from every footer. The privacy page now cites what Cloudflare documents, lists every preference stored in your browser and says the site itself sets no cookies.

quieter-navigation.title: A quieter language suggestion and roomier note navigation
quieter-navigation.description: The language suggestion is now a small line of text shown only on Spanish pages, the English menu says plainly Notes, the under-construction banner is gone, and the previous/next links have room below the article.

minimal-appearance.title: A calmer, more minimal look with smaller type
minimal-appearance.description: The home now has a minimal preset that hides the hero pills, the lab log and the pillars strip. Text sizes follow a smaller theme-driven scale, note pages are calmer and the banner edge is consistent.

pixel-display-font.title: Pixel font on the home hero and section titles
pixel-display-font.description: The home headline and section titles now use Pixelify Sans, self-hosted like the other fonts.

mobile-touch-pass.title: Easier to use on a phone
mobile-touch-pass.description: Controls have at least a 44 px tap area, the home banner is shorter on phones, the code copy button has its own strip on touch screens, and hiding the navbar closes the open menu.

loading-performance.title: Pages load with fewer delays
loading-performance.description: The main fonts are preloaded, the profile photo is optimized, the animated banner pauses when it is off screen, and links are prefetched when you hover them.

note-translations.title: Notes can link to their translation
note-translations.description: A note can point to its translation in the other language, with a language switch on the page and hreflang tags for search engines.

hiring-card-wording.title: Hiring card reads more openly
hiring-card-wording.description: The card now says I am working at Buo and open to chat, instead of simply not being available. The profile share card carries the same wording.

full-preset.title: Back to the fuller home look
full-preset.description: The home shows the hero chips and the pillars strip again, with the larger type of the original look.

hiring-card-layout.title: Hiring card: a clearer status
hiring-card-layout.description: Where I work now is a headline and "open to chat" is its own tag, so the status no longer wraps onto two lines or shows a red dot.

now-card.title: A Now card on the home
now-card.description: The Lab log box is replaced by a dated card with what I am focused on and what I am learning. It is edited from the site config.

english-notes-link.title: "All notes" in English no longer leads to a missing page
english-notes-link.description: On the English home and profile the link pointed to a page that does not exist. It now opens the notes index.

cv-per-language.title: CV in Spanish and English
cv-per-language.description: The CV button opens the PDF in the language of the page you are reading.

profile-from-cv.title: Profile updated from my CV
profile-from-cv.description: The experience is now in English on the English profile, the stack lists my professional tools, and the courses name their real platforms.

me-portrait.title: A portrait on the profile page
me-portrait.description: The profile page now shows a photo of me, and so does the preview card you see when sharing that page. The home keeps the illustrated avatar.

profile-card-status-dot.title: The shared profile card no longer shows a red dot
profile-card-status-dot.description: The preview card of the profile page showed a red dot next to "open to chat". It now uses the brand colour, like the hiring card on the home.

rss-feed.title: RSS feed for the notes
rss-feed.description: You can follow the Lab Notes at /rss.xml. Every page advertises the feed, so feed readers find it on their own.

readme-and-guides.title: README and configuration guides in Spanish and English
readme-and-guides.description: The repository explains how to run, configure and white-label the site in both languages, and the configuration tables are generated from the code so they cannot drift.

open-licence.title: Open licence: MIT for the code, CC BY-NC-SA for the notes
open-licence.description: The code can be reused under the MIT licence; the notes keep a non-commercial share-alike licence.

languages-in-page-language.title: Languages on the profile are named in the page language
languages-in-page-language.description: The quick facts on the profile now read Spanish and English in the language of the page instead of the same mixed text on both.

faster-browser-tests.title: Browser tests run about 30% faster
faster-browser-tests.description: The full suite takes about 73 seconds instead of 107 on a 12-core machine, and a one-viewport script exists for day-to-day work.

balanced-type-scale.title: Smaller text sizes and cleaner line breaks
balanced-type-scale.description: Headings and card titles are a little smaller, so titles no longer take four or five lines on a phone, and paragraphs avoid a last line with a single word. The figures strip and the availability line on the profile also wrap more tidily.

whole-note-cards.title: Whole note cards are clickable
whole-note-cards.description: In the notes list and in the latest note on the home you can click or tap anywhere on the card, not only on the title.

background-picker-touch.title: The background picker is hidden where it does nothing
background-picker-touch.description: On touch screens and with reduced motion the animated background never runs, so its picker button is no longer shown there.

latin-fonts-only.title: Pages are about 4 KB lighter
latin-fonts-only.description: The self-hosted fonts now ship only the Latin alphabets that Spanish and English use, which keeps the notes pages within their loading budget.

external-links-new-tab.title: Links to other sites open in a new tab
external-links-new-tab.description: Links that leave the site open in a new tab so you do not lose your place in the blog; links inside the site stay in the same tab.

blog-feature-flag.title: Turning the blog off now removes it
blog-feature-flag.description: With `features.blog` off, the notes pages, the RSS feed and the notes entries in the sitemap are no longer built, so a fork can keep only the portfolio. This site keeps the blog on and its output is unchanged.

background-back-button.title: The animated background survives the Back button
background-back-button.description: Going to another page and pressing Back no longer leaves a blank banner with a broken-image icon: the background pauses instead of being destroyed and starts again when the page comes back.

contact-linkedin-and-sending.title: LinkedIn next to the contact form, and a spoken "sending" state
contact-linkedin-and-sending.description: The contact page now offers LinkedIn right under the form as an alternative, and screen readers hear a status message while a message is being sent. A failed send keeps what you typed.

language-switch-home-label.title: The language switch says when it goes to the home page
language-switch-home-label.description: On a note that has no translation, the language switch and the language hint now say they lead to the home page in the other language instead of implying a translated page.

me-portrait-size.title: The /me portrait loads about 20 times lighter
me-portrait-size.description: The portrait on /me was a 231 KB image shown in a slot a few hundred pixels wide. It is now resized to what the slot needs (about 12 KB on a phone) and loaded with high priority, which in a simulated slow-phone test brought the largest paint of the page from about 2.5 s to about 1.4 s.

focus-not-hidden-by-header.title: Keyboard focus no longer hides under the fixed header
focus-not-hidden-by-header.description: Moving focus up the page with Shift+Tab, or following an in-page link, no longer leaves the focused link or field covered by the sticky header.

contact-focus-after-error.title: The contact form keeps keyboard focus after a failed send
contact-focus-after-error.description: When sending a message fails, focus returns to the send button instead of being lost, so keyboard and screen reader users can retry right away without tabbing from the top of the page.

favicon-ico.title: /favicon.ico no longer answers 404
favicon-ico.description: Browsers, crawlers and link previews ask for /favicon.ico by default. The site now serves a small real icon there (5 KB) next to the SVG one, so those requests succeed. Forks should replace both files.

lighthouse-fixture-fix.title: The performance gate measures the page production serves
lighthouse-fixture-fix.description: The test build used by the Lighthouse gate was inlining the site stylesheet twice, so it measured a page about 43 KB heavier than the real one. It now matches the real build, and the gate's slowest simulated paint on the note page improved from about 2.4 s to 2.3 s with a wider margin to the budget.

preact-11.title: Preact 11 and routine tooling updates
preact-11.description: The interactive parts of the site now run on Preact 11 (the contact form field was rewritten to satisfy its stricter input types, with no visible change), and the build tools (sharp, vitest, wrangler, Biome, dependency-cruiser) and the CI mise action were updated. Forks should expect the same.

note-003-vibe-coding.title: New Lab Note 003: vibe coding or specify first
note-003-vibe-coding.description: Why I define intent, scope and decisions in writing before asking an AI for code, what it gives me, what it costs to keep up to date and where I still experiment. Written from a rollback at work and from this site's own documents.
